findings.title: Identical-endpoint rewrite shortcut refutes a reachable later declared join
findings.status: bounded direct-source probe reproduced alongside58passing existing owner tests
findings.detail: With aa->a, the two distinct reductions of aaa both end at aa. With no declared join the host returns Joined(aa), but declaring the true later common reduct a returns NeedsEvidence because the equality shortcut treats unequal-to-endpoint as refuted. Check declared-join reachability within budget even when endpoints coincide; preserve the host's nearest join aa when the declaration is valid, and distinguish unchecked from refuted.
findings.limits: False refusal and testimony-dependent verdict, not false proof of non-joinability. Existing distant-join tests cover unequal endpoints and miss this branch.

findings.title: Operad source-span verification panics at an interior UTF8 byte offset
findings.detail: For document é and offsets[1,2], bounds pass but direct string slicing panics because offset1 is not a UTF8 character boundary. Use str::get(start..end) or explicit character-boundary checks and return ImmutableSpanViolation. Clarify that offsets are byte offsets, not interchangeable character offsets.
findings.limits: Two-byte public string only; no provider or external document used.

findings.title: Operad decoy neutralization accepts a mathematically false refutation string
findings.detail: A matching decoy with provided evaluation '1 != 1' is Neutralized. The predicate only checks that the text contains !=; equation, action and stored reference witness are ignored. Evaluate a declared exact relation against the candidate or label the result as an unchecked refutation assertion, not a sound refutation witness.
findings.limits: No downstream authority promotion demonstrated; local declared neutralization predicate is inadequate.

findings.title: Operad tree conversion confuses original child index with current flattened input slot
findings.status: current source establishes slot semantics; bounded cached-kernel probe reproduced
findings.detail: An accepted outer[A,B]->R tree with first child[X,Y]->A has flattened inputs[X,Y,B] after first substitution. The next iteration substitutes childB into slot1 (Y), refusing a valid coloured tree. Substitute original children right-to-left or track the expanded boundary offset. Add zero-, unary- and multi-input child cases and verify the resulting tree, not only arity.
findings.limits: Runtime owner included verbatim; kernel execution uses explicitly hashed cached core_operad_theory. Current kernel source was read for flattened-leaf substitution, but no full rebuild/source-binary identity is claimed.

findings.title: Null-tree absorption changes the enclosing operation output colour and bypasses graft bounds
findings.status: node and graft counterexamples reproduced; recursive ideal route source-established
findings.detail: For outer[A,B]->R and null child of colourA, node returns null of colourA instead ofR. Grafting that null at slot999 succeeds before checking any bound/type. Preserve the enclosing boundary when propagating the ideal and define/check which partial compositions are admissible before absorbing; do the same in recursive ideal evaluation.
findings.limits: Local coloured-tree law failure. The kernel itself rejects NullTree conversion; no certificate or external execution is inferred.

findings.title: Signed homology boundary accumulator can declare a nonzero integer boundary closed
findings.status: exact original-function probe reproduced in both overflow modes
findings.detail: Two copies of edge(0,1) each with coefficient i64::MIN have nonzero boundary coefficients ±2^64. Checked mode panics; unchecked arithmetic wraps both vertex totals tozero and returns true. Use exact BigInt or checked arithmetic with typed refusal, and distinguish integral from modular closure.
findings.limits: Complete original function extracted without edits, not a full module build. Two edge terms suffice; no large allocation or geometric interpretation claim.

findings.title: F2 matrix shape multiplication overflows at both constructor and JSON boundary
findings.status: bounded direct-source probe reproduced in both overflow modes
findings.detail: On this 64-bit target, rows=2^63, cols=2 and empty data panic with overflow checks enabled and are admitted as a zero-storage matrix when checks are disabled. JSON deserialization routes through the same multiplication and shows the same outcomes. Use checked_mul and explicit resource ceilings before comparing or allocating; zeros and derived result allocation require the same protection.
findings.limits: No large allocation or unbounded operation was attempted. Exhaustive small matrices separately passed 5054 linear-system and 1024 gauge cases per overflow mode; those checks do not cover arbitrary sizes.

findings.title: Curriculum deduplication digest merges nonisomorphic connected graphs
findings.detail: The digest retains only sorted vertex degrees and sorted weights. K3,3 and the triangular prism, both connected six-vertex nine-edge graphs with unit weights, receive the same digest although their triangle counts are 0 and 2, proving they are not relabellings. Use a declared canonical graph encoding/isomorphism procedure or explicitly label this a coarse invariant and do not deduplicate solely by it. The generator also ignores its seed: seeds0 and1 produce identical instances.
findings.limits: This is an exact preimage-encoding alias, not a SHA256 collision. The fixed generated family may not currently contain both graphs; the public digest helper and stated arbitrary relabelling-dedup claim exceed that narrow family.

findings.title: Extension resolution uses a detector unbound to the preservation witness
findings.detail: A positive exhausted source s is preserved with detector value1 in extension {s,new}. ExtensionCandidate::evaluate receives a different callback returning0 at s; assessment accepts that same preserved source as the unique resolving candidate. Bind the candidate detector to the exact extended detector used for preservation, or recompute the complete declared extended table once and reuse that witness. Context/source strings alone do not establish this relation.
findings.limits: Additive finite foundation outside the consequential host protocol; no authority promotion or operational effect demonstrated. Arbitrary callbacks also assume extensionality and termination.

findings.title: Native canonical decoder admits values rejected by the Python closed wire algebra
findings.detail: Rust accepts invalid and uppercase byte hex, duplicate/unsorted set members, duplicate mapping keys, a non-builtin mapping type, non-field dataclass children, duplicate dataclass field names and empty enum identities. Python rejects all nine. Match the declared strict canonical image, including uniqueness/order/type/hex gates, and add negative parity vectors. Public CanonicalValue variants separately allow bypassing decoder gates when encoding.
findings.limits: This establishes decoder acceptance drift, not a cryptographic hash collision or an executed authority exploit. Standard JSON-to-canonical encoding follows a narrower path and was not shown to admit these malformed compound wires.

findings.title: Exported enforcement macros fail when instantiated
findings.status: two bounded direct-source expansion probes reproduced
findings.detail: __impl_contract_base invokes a non-const assert_impl in const evaluation (E0015). attach_contract_laws appends a turbofish to an opaque path fragment and fails parsing. Every implementation wrapper invokes the base macro. Replace dead/runtime assertion scaffolding with valid type-level bounds or executed tests; test representative actual expansions and bind captured parameter names. Intended nested _run is not called and therefore would not execute a runtime law assertion even after syntax repair.
findings.limits: Exact original macro module included unchanged with minimal type scaffolding. Does not claim the containing crate fails when macros remain unexpanded, nor that all generated wrappers were individually compiled.

findings.title: Flattened enforcement generator no longer reproduces its committed owner
findings.status: source-established; mutating generator deliberately not run
findings.detail: Generator writes sibling macros.rs, not current enforcement_macros.rs, and emits neither current boundary types nor shared capacity additions; its assert binding body also differs. Its byte-for-byte reproduction claim is therefore stale in this layout. Align the destination/generated boundary and perform generation into temporary storage before comparing and atomically replacing an explicitly authorized owner.
findings.limits: No source files regenerated or replaced; no assertion about historical layout or referenced tests outside this frozen scope.

findings.title: Maintenance canonical encoder accepts nonfinite floats as null
findings.detail: Generic Serialize values NaN,+infinity,-infinity are converted by serde_json::to_value to Null before the float check and produce the same bytes/digest as None. Finite1.5 is refused. Reject floats at the serializer boundary, or constrain the public API to an already checked integer JSON carrier and describe the information loss explicitly.
findings.limits: Three scalar cases only; current maintenance DTOs themselves use integer fields, so no claim of an already exercised live maintenance bypass or cryptographic collision.

findings.title: Maintenance raw-byte decoder accepts malformed and noncanonical base64 padding
findings.detail: AA=A decodes as two zero bytes despite misplaced padding; AA==AAAA accepts padding before the final quartet; AB== accepts nonzero unused bits and decodes identically to canonical AA==. Require final-quartet-only contiguous padding and zero unused bits, or use a strict existing decoder. Add negative cases beside the valid raw-byte roundtrip test.
findings.limits: Input acceptance/encoding reproducibility defect; separately recomputed raw SHA can still protect semantic byte identity. No forged hash or authority promotion demonstrated.

findings.title: Authorization scaffold exposes fabricable verified signatures and reusable mutable permits
findings.status: bounded direct-source probe reproduced; no live landing caller found
findings.detail: External code can construct VerifiedOperatorSignature without TrustStore, self-register a lease, build caller-supplied equal transcripts and obtain Lander admission for an unrelated candidate. SingleUseStepPermit is public-field Clone and may be edited/copied after admission. Lander checks only nonempty fence base and signature sealed/base string equality; it does not bind candidate/tree/policy or validate GitHub review meaning. Keep this explicitly provisional or require opaque trusted handles, content bindings and atomically consumed permits before any consequential integration.
findings.limits: rg over code/rust found Lander admission only in this owner tests. No real filesystem landing, privilege escalation, signature forgery or operational use is demonstrated.

findings.title: Authorization MAC omits framing between unconstrained commit and base strings
findings.detail: The same synthetic-key MAC verifies both(sealed=ab,base=c) and(sealed=a,base=bc), because raw strings are concatenated without lengths or domain tags. Enforce fixed canonical commit widths and/or frame every field with domain/version tags; bind operator and candidate identity as required by the authorization contract.
findings.limits: Current API admits arbitrary strings; if callers separately enforce equal fixed SHA widths this particular pair is excluded. This is message-encoding ambiguity, not a BLAKE3 collision or recovered secret.

findings.title: Consistent authorization cut admits reversed collection intervals and unbounded observation epochs
findings.detail: Transcript intervals[100,1] and[2,0] with observations at epoch9999 pass because only t1.end<=t2.start is checked. Validate each start<=end and every observed epoch within its collection interval, then document the trusted monotone revision/source assumptions needed for a real double-collect snapshot.
findings.limits: Equal source labels/payload/revisions are finite declared consistency only; authentic observation acquisition and current revocation remain outside this scaffold.

findings.title: Decode bias ceiling panics or accepts i32 minimum instead of refusing
findings.status: bounded unchanged-owner probe reproduced in both overflow modes
findings.detail: A synthetic LOGIT_BIAS receipt with bias=-2147483648 reaches bias.abs(). With overflow checks enabled this panics; with checks disabled abs remains negative and the >1000 predicate is false, producing Pass. Use a range comparison or checked/unsigned absolute value and test both signed extremes.
findings.limits: Tests the declared receipt verifier, not a real provider logit intervention. Entire original owner included unchanged with cached serde; no full-crate run.

findings.title: JCS raw parser accepts malformed JSON and public serializer emits duplicate unsorted keys
findings.detail: canonicalize_str accepts01,1. and literal newline inside JSON string; serde_json rejects those same inputs. serialize_jcs preserves arbitrary unsorted duplicate keys in public JcsValue::Object. Enforce strict number/string grammar and canonicalize or validate public object vectors.
findings.limits: 1e01 was a valid control accepted by both; vertical-tab prefix was rejected by both. No exhaustive RFC parity claim.

findings.title: JCS integer bound can panic or silently admit oversized integers
findings.detail: Value i64::MIN overflows abs: checked build panics, unchecked emits-9223372036854776000 despite advertised2^53-1 ceiling. Raw50-digit integer skips ceiling when i128 parse fails. Compare signed ranges without abs and reject integer parse overflow before f64 conversion.
findings.limits: Concerns this advertised restricted integer profile, not a claim all RFC8785 numeric values must be safe integers. No hash collision claim.

findings.title: Strict diff gate accepts malformed positions and incomplete sections
findings.detail: Accepted nonnumeric hunk start positions, unsafe Binary files traversal names by ignoring validation errors, and a second plain header-only section by inheriting section_has_change. Validate positions, propagate all path errors and reset/finalize every section.
findings.limits: No patch applied or filesystem escape demonstrated; unsafe metadata example retained only benign diff--git path.

findings.title: Lean scanner loses token boundaries and axiom parser overwrites contrary evidence
findings.detail: Scanning theorem t:False:=by/-comment-/sorry reports clean because comment removal merges bysorry. A t line with sorryAx followed by repeated t line claiming no axioms produces PASS under supplied true build/harness flags. Preserve comment separators and reject conflicting duplicate declaration records; bind actual compiler output and required declaration inventory.
findings.limits: No Lean compilation occurred; demonstrates scanner/text-audit behavior, not kernel unsoundness.

findings.title: Research claim verifier accepts inconsistent receipts and manifest omits identity
findings.detail: Changing source IDs/paths while retaining bytes leaves source_manifest_root unchanged. Verifier accepts absent observed hash/count and wrong manifest with match booleans true; empty receipt set passes all(). Frame identity/path/normalization/count into manifest and recheck independently pinned expected source evidence. Scope verifier to custody unless a claim predicate is supplied.
findings.limits: Intake computes real raw byte hashes; neither SHA collision nor scientific claim verification occurs.

findings.title: Synthesis freeze bypasses declared dependency and oracle requirements
findings.detail: Pending module depending on missing node is frozen with invalid code by freeze_module and is_all_frozen returns true. Require admitted verification receipt and valid status/dependency transition; validate unique acyclic graph names and trusted mutable-state boundary.
findings.limits: No code executed; public scaffold API contradicts its header, not a demonstrated deployed oracle bypass.

findings.title: Symbol Game host does not enforce immutable well-formed problem across public API
findings.detail: Public problem bypasses new(); try_new checks only digest, admitting recomputed negative-weight graph with negative defect. After bootstrap, changing initial_claims without updating stored digest still permits ZERO_OBSTRUCTION verification under old pin. Make admitted problem/host state opaque or revalidate positive weights, dimensions and digest at boundaries.
findings.limits: In-process API mutation demonstrated, no remote transport mutation path. Weak duality remains sound under the valid positive-weight graph premises.

findings.title: Prime host accepts a timeout budget but never enforces it
findings.detail: timeout_ms is range-checked and committed, but the complete host.rs/host/prime_execution.rs path never reads elapsed time or propagates a deadline to solve/replay. Add an enforceable work/deadline mechanism or identify this field explicitly as external supervisor metadata.
findings.limits: Source-established; no expensive solver run or observed wall-clock overrun. Dense-size fences remain real.

findings.title: Challenge commit-reveal gate does not bind the revealed judge
findings.detail: Changing hidden cases, checker IDs/operator/version, judge commitment hash and timestamp passes the prerequisite verifier with the original commitment/freeze/deliverable. manifest_sha256 is never compared to a canonical reveal, and variable operator/version concatenation admits an exact field-boundary alias. Bind and verify a canonical framed judge manifest, checker identities and independently anchored event order; validate None authority.
findings.limits: Synthetic in-memory unchanged-owner probe; not a SHA collision, not a private benchmark attack or deployed exploit.

findings.title: Challenge scoring passes the answer-bearing full case to the candidate
findings.detail: ExactMatchChecker reads expected_field from case, while evaluator serializes that entire case as the candidate command argument. Echoing that object is Correct for both checkers; checker independence/IDs are never enforced and the same object can be supplied twice. Separate public candidate input from judge-only expected data and bind distinct checker implementations to the reveal.
findings.limits: Pure checker probe models source-proven argument construction; no sandbox execution, actual cases or private key accessed. Arbitrary custom checkers may use different case conventions.

findings.title: Checker panics escape the advertised CheckerDefectPause boundary
findings.detail: evaluate_dual_checkers handles returned Err values but calls each trait implementation without panic isolation. Synthetic checker panic unwinds instead of producing CheckerDefectPause. Specify a nonpanicking checker contract and isolate untrusted checkers, or catch recoverable unwind at a suitable boundary while preserving crash distinction.
findings.limits: Recovered by the probe outside the unchanged function; panic=abort cannot be caught. Does not show Rust memory unsafety.

findings.title: CODA truncates fractional exact distance to an accepted zero
findings.detail: For d0=[[2],[3]], cochain=[0,1], d1=[], exact min_t |2t|+|3t-1|=2/3. BigRational.to_u64 truncates to0, so declared phi1_distance0 is accepted with ExactRepair/CheckPassed. Require denominator1 before integer conversion or compare exact rationals directly. Add fractional positive-distance negatives.
findings.limits: Authority remains Refused/None and premises declared. Original CODA source included unchanged with only canonical serialization shim; cached exact solver dependencies pinned in receipt. Mixed-artifact failed attempts retained.

findings.title: MCP computation-only declaration still exposes live provider and filesystem actions
findings.status: source-established complete dispatch tracing; no provider execution
findings.detail: tool_actions removes only run_folder_seal/verify. anthropic_messages and *_file remain callable and dispatch to credential/network/file owners despite advertised no provider calls and computation over supplied bytes. Use an explicit pure-action allowlist or accurately declare effects with separate host authorization/capabilities; do not equate AuthorityEffect None with no external effects.
findings.limits: A live provider call still requires valid input, positive ceiling and configured credentials; no paid call, key discovery, socket or source mutation was performed.

findings.title: Prime replay labels an unexecuted compound operation conforming
findings.detail: A single step255, opCRT, executedfalse produces conforms=true/Terminalized. Receipt CRT without gamma2 or steps also conforms with arbitrary caller terminal. Validate per-step closed op identity, execution, ordering and required evidence, or label this as a letter-declaration lint.
findings.limits: No coordinator/descent execution; existing unchecked-laws list does not mention these additional omissions.

findings.title: Examiner asymmetry predicate ignores self-loops
findings.detail: verify_examiner on {(0,0)} reports is_asymmetric=true because selfloops are excluded from symmetric_witnesses. Include irreflexivity in asymmetry or collect loops as reciprocal witnesses. is_strict still refuses loops, but checks only irreflexivity/asymmetry and cannot certify transitivity; a directed3cycle passes is_strict.
findings.limits: Exact finite synthetic relation; cycle observation is a naming/strict-partial-order scope limit, not failure of the narrower irreflexive-asymmetric conjunction.

findings.title: A permitted nonASCII presentation codec rejects its own render
findings.detail: with_glyphs(0x80,0x81) succeeds, render casts each byte tochar and emits multibyteUTF8, then scan compares individual bytes againstoriginal glyphvalues and refuses. Restrict codecs to distinctASCII bytes or represent glyphs consistently aschars/bytes.
findings.limits: One finite depth1 public constructor roundtrip; canonicalASCII codec unaffected.

findings.title: Observer equivalence lacks the purity premise required for reflexivity
findings.detail: EvaluationMorphism is an arbitrary function pointer. A function using an atomic counter returns different exact rationals for the two identical admitted contexts, so equivalent(x,x)=false. Require/document deterministic pure evaluators and bind their identity; memoization alone does not establish all equivalence laws.
findings.limits: Synthetic stateful evaluator, no concurrency/provider/private inputs. With pure deterministic functions every currently opaque datum remains indistinguishable, as render ignores datum.

findings.title: Deserialized bytecode executes under a stale bundle digest
findings.detail: Private fields derive Deserialize without digest reconstruction. Changing LoadGlyph glyph1 to99 in serialized bundle preserves original digest in execution receipt. Validate wire via constructor and recompute/bind bundle plus initial envelope at execution.
findings.limits: Unchanged-source native probe reproduced; no external programs.

findings.title: Repeating boundary assertion promotes unresolved defect to exact
findings.detail: EmitObstruction followed by two AssertBoundary operations yields exact=true while defect_count remains1. The second check treats an inexact Boundary as non-Defect. Preserve prior inexactness and require actual boundary-map computation before mathematical exactness claims.
findings.limits: Unchanged-source native probe reproduced; symbolic instruction semantics only.

findings.title: Fiber continuation overflows instead of refusing
findings.detail: A supplied Fiber level u64MAX followed by StepFibration panics with overflow checks and wraps to0 without them. Use checked_add and typed refusal.
findings.limits: Both native overflow modes reproduced; hand-constructed public envelope.

findings.title: Guard generalization can bypass review and preserve an obsolete mask digest
findings.status: bounded native probe reproduced in both overflow modes
findings.detail: Public LearnedGuard/scope fields and Deserialize admit generalized scope without named review. Mask digest omits scope/reviewer/rationale, so changing exact matching into token-only pruning preserves digest. Validate all constructors/wire and hash complete behavior/review evidence.
findings.limits: Source-established, not a newly executed guard probe; bounded known-good panel cannot establish universal soundness. Bounded direct-source confirmation is recorded in RPF-V023; no authority exploit or broad soundness claim.

findings.title: CODA wire bypasses layer and named-review gates
findings.detail: Deserialize admits a Physical AdmittedClaim carrying ParityWitness and a QuarantinedAdapter certificate with empty reviewer/rationale; author_receipt succeeds. Use validated wire conversion and distinguish evidence-tag checks from actual evidence verification.
findings.limits: Both bypasses reproduced against unchanged source. No physical or parity truth inferred.

findings.title: Retraction replay ignores material receipt fields
findings.status: bounded native probe reproduced in both overflow modes
findings.detail: Replay compares terminal, trace and cemetery but ignores schema, acts, admitted/refused counts, open-obligation count within same terminal category and authority effect. Tampering those fields remains Reproduced. Compare the complete canonical receipt or explicitly name a narrower replay predicate.
findings.limits: Source-established; authority string acceptance is not demonstrated external authority issuance. Bounded direct-source confirmation is recorded in RPF-V023; no authority exploit or broad soundness claim.

findings.title: Debate localization omits its monotonicity and common-proposition premises
findings.status: bounded native probe reproduced in both overflow modes
findings.detail: Binary search assumes prefix agreement followed by permanent disagreement. Public DAG permits nonmonotone bits; a local previous-node check cannot establish first divergence. Comparisons also ignore primitive identity and intentionally compare different propositions, so differing truth bits need not be contradictory. Encode/check premises or narrow the contract to locating a local bit transition.
findings.limits: Source-established with monotone-only existing fixtures; no fresh debate execution yet. Bounded direct-source confirmation is recorded in RPF-V023; no authority exploit or broad soundness claim.

findings.title: Live admission lets its request choose the signature verifier and trust file
findings.detail: A request may nominate any ssh_keygen executable; verification accepts only its success exit status. The same request chooses allowed_signers_path, constrained merely to outside repository. Thus the gate does not independently authenticate operator approval against an untrusted caller. Pin executable/trust roots in host configuration, or state/enforce that this caller is already fully trusted. Child wait has no timeout.
findings.limits: No live admission, credential resolution, provider request or arbitrary program was executed. If callers are already trusted operators, this is a trust-boundary/documentation requirement rather than privilege escalation.

findings.title: Injected transport path omits advertised run resource admission checks
findings.detail: dispatch/run rejects zero compute budget and max_output_tokens outside1..65536. Public execute_with_transport validates only objective/rounds and common preflight, then enters execute without those checks. Centralize resource admission before both entry points.
findings.limits: Downstream owners may refuse some invalid values; no paid transport or end-to-end execution was attempted.

findings.title: Empty or initially refused DDC tape heads do not bind initial state
findings.detail: The head starts as SHA256(genesis_root) and incorporates state only after a successful step. Distinct admitted initial states with zero steps have identical lawful=true receipt_head, and distinct first-step refusals also preserve that head. Bind initial state and full request separately, or clearly document head as accepted-prefix-only identity rather than complete request custody.
findings.limits: No collision in SHA256 asserted. Dispatcher may independently bind an outer request in some call paths; the public verify_tape result itself does not.

findings.title: Grammar probability score accepts duplicate mass and foreign-prefix binding
findings.status: bounded native probe reproduced in both overflow modes
findings.detail: Two probability1 entries for legal token0 produce EFG2. The resulting EFG can be attached to an unrelated missed prefix with support0. Validate distinct token IDs and total mass<=1, bind score to grammar/prefix/distribution, and describe it as immediate legal-token mass unless a finite-horizon model is actually evaluated.
findings.limits: Native hand-constructed finite example reproduced. No model distribution or generation run; immediate legal mass is not in general a lower bound on multi-step completion probability.

findings.title: Unsigned active count makes allegedly monotone pressure decrease
findings.status: bounded native probe reproduced in both overflow modes
findings.detail: For weight1 and initial0, step([u64MAX]) returns pressure-1 because count as i64 wraps the value before rational multiplication. Use BigInt-backed rational/counts or checked conversion/arithmetic with typed refusal. Positive weights plus u64 counts do not establish the claimed invariant under this implementation.
findings.limits: Reproduced in both Rust overflow modes against unchanged source; small allocation, no long run.

findings.title: Deserialized prompt graph bypasses construction and can index outside Laplacian
findings.detail: PromptGraph derives Deserialize for private prompts/distance/radius/adjacency. Wire may supply inconsistent adjacency or out-of-range neighbor index; laplacian writes row[other] without validation. Deserialize through the constructor or validate complete simple symmetric bounded adjacency and its relation to prompts.
findings.limits: Source-established; no native graph panic probe yet. Constructor-produced graphs avoid this specific indexing defect.

findings.title: Guard fingerprint serialization has an exact field-boundary alias
findings.status: bounded native probe reproduced in both overflow modes
findings.detail: token a with projection[false] hashes identically to token a followed by NUL with emptyprojection. Use tagged length framing. Actual exact pruning compares fields, so digest alias does not itself cause erroneous equality in that path.
findings.limits: Native probe reproduced, no cryptographic hash collision asserted.

findings.title: Challenge score emits VERIFIED without verifying commitment, freeze or cases binding
findings.detail: run_challenge_score merely deserializes, runs two instances of the same ExactMatchChecker over caller-provided cases, and copies independent commitment/freeze hashes into the result. It never checks challenge IDs, judge commitment, frozen deliverable or linkage between candidate outputs and deliverable. Empty hidden_cases yields VERIFIED by0==0. The happy-path test itself commits text naming two cases but supplies one. Require validated reveal/freeze/manifest linkage and declared nonempty evaluation census before emitting a challenge verification status; distinguish checker duplication from independence.
findings.limits: Pure source/control-flow finding; this endpoint was not executed in a live challenge. Extends the core challenge binding limitations in RPF-F047/F048 without claiming a private benchmark breach.

findings.title: Kitaev adapter names boundary isolation topological protection
findings.detail: mzm_topologically_protected is exactly left_isolated && right_isolated, with no spectral-gap, nontrivial-phase or perturbation-stability predicate. A zero Hamiltonian has zero boundary commutators without establishing protected edge physics. Rename this result to the computed boundary-isolation predicate or add and explicitly scope the missing mathematical conditions.
findings.limits: Adapter source review only; no physical experiment and no claim of a general phase-classification algorithm in the delegated owner.

findings.title: Surgery verifier certifies a single repeated defect and trusts fabricated counts
findings.status: bounded native probe reproduced in both overflow modes
findings.detail: On d0=[0],d1=[1], fused=(0,0), sigma_before=[1], positive/negative witnesses=[1], sigma_after=[0] receives Verified. This removes one defect, contradicting the advertised exactly-two result. Public counts99/97 also survive verifier and receipt unchanged. Require distinct in-range indices, recompute counts and bind verdict inside receipt construction; add independent forged-pair/count tests.
findings.limits: Solver-produced pairs are distinct; this failure is in the independent public witness-verification/receipt boundary. No downstream authority promotion or provider run.

findings.title: Transport serde bypasses monotone in-range morphism admission
findings.status: bounded native probe reproduced in both overflow modes
findings.detail: Derived Deserialize constructs private SimplicialMorphism fields directly. Map[1,0] into2, which new refuses, receives a transport certificate; map[9] into1 reaches unchecked pushforward indexing and panics. Deserialize through validated constructor and validate any public receipt before use.
findings.limits: Runtime simplicial_transport constructs with new and avoids this particular serde bypass. Public Rust/serde interface still admits it; no external host exploit asserted.

findings.title: Derivation DAG completeness receipts substitute literal arithmetic for named claim verification
findings.status: source-established; fixed master output reproduced natively
findings.detail: All33 families pass and list177 unique nodes, but no DAG/paper/dependency/proof inputs are read. Examples: growth minima assigned1; Cabello146 computed2+72+72; Majorana validity assigned comm_trace_zero; completeness counts hard-coded;142 node witnesses depend on index/stage arithmetic rather than named propositions. Tranche7 even compares literals1 and3/4 although its documented R_t(p) formula gives R_1(1)=1. Preserve as illustrative finite fixtures and remove semantic-closure/certification implications, or bind each covered node to an actual owner predicate, premises and checked evidence.
findings.limits: Some small exact examples and finite CHSH/parity enumerations are valid. This finding does not refute separate paper or Lean proofs; it rejects promoting this native receipt to their verification or to quantum-selection/physical evidence.

findings.title: Transport chain ledger omits composition carrier compatibility
findings.status: bounded native probe reproduced in both overflow modes
findings.detail: F:[0]->carrier3 and G:[0,1]->carrier2 cannot compose under the public typed dimension rule, yet for_chain(F,G,[0]) returns two loss ledgers because reached indices fit. Check first.target_vertices==then.source_vertices or explicitly expose a restriction/extension morphism and rename the weaker operation.
findings.limits: The support-relative telescoping count still has its stated elementary interpretation; this is inconsistency with the module composition contract, not a false numerical sum.

Full exploration of both reachable sets within a shared probe budget
Host-owned presentation pins for endorsed provenance

The budget counts candidate redex probes, excluding path replay, critical-pair enumeration and string/allocation costs.
